theme: 3 terms on how the compiler makes Swift fast: optimizing a whole module at once, making a type-specific copy of generic code, and letting other modules see a function's body

terms.definition: A build mode where the compiler optimizes all files of a module together.
terms.example: Release builds use Whole Module Optimization, so they take longer but run faster.

terms.definition: When the optimizer copies a generic function for one exact type, so it runs faster.
terms.example: Generic Specialization only happens with optimization on, so measure in a release build.

terms.definition: An attribute, written `@inlinable`, that puts a public function's body in the module's interface so other modules can optimize it.
terms.example: Mark the helper Inlinable, the app calls it from another module in a hot loop.

quizzes.question: In this code, what does the optimizer do when it makes a version of `twice` just for `Int`?
quizzes.code:
func twice<T: Numeric>(_ x: T) -> T { x + x }
print(twice(21))

quizzes.question: Which attribute lets other modules see and optimize a public function's body?
Which build mode lets the compiler optimize all files of one module together?

video.title: Whole Module Optimization, Generic Specialization & Inlinable | Day 80
video.description:
Learn to explain how the optimizer speeds up generic code in Swift: Whole Module Optimization, Generic Specialization & Inlinable, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Whole Module Optimization - A build mode where the compiler optimizes all files of a module together.
Generic Specialization - When the optimizer copies a generic function for one exact type, so it runs faster.
Inlinable - An attribute, written `@inlinable`, that puts a public function's body in the module's interface so other modules can optimize it.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 80 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: Swift Whole Module Optimization, Generic Specialization & Inlinable | Day 80
landscape.description:
Explain Whole Module Optimization, Generic Specialization & Inlinable in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
전체 모듈 최적화, 제네릭 특수화, Inlinable 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Whole Module Optimization - A build mode where the compiler optimizes all files of a module together.
한국어: 전체 모듈 최적화: 컴파일러가 한 모듈의 모든 파일을 함께 최적화하는 빌드 모드

Generic Specialization - When the optimizer copies a generic function for one exact type, so it runs faster.
한국어: 제네릭 특수화: 최적화기가 제네릭 함수를 특정 타입 전용으로 복사해서 더 빠르게 돌게 하는 것

Inlinable - An attribute, written `@inlinable`, that puts a public function's body in the module's interface so other modules can optimize it.
한국어: Inlinable: `@inlinable`로 쓰는 속성으로, public 함수의 본문을 모듈 인터페이스에 넣어 다른 모듈이 최적화할 수 있게 함

In this video, Mina and Jake find out why a generic helper from a package was slow in the app and how one attribute lets the optimizer do its job, to close Phase 2, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

landscape.hook: Same generic code, slow in the app. Can you explain why in English?

dialogue.title: Why was total slow?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, why did you mark `total` as Inlinable?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The app calls it from another module, MathKit.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Without it, the app usually sees only the signature, not the body.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Generic Specialization needs the body to build a version for one exact type.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Doesn't Whole Module Optimization fix that?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only within MathKit. Whole Module Optimization can't see our app.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So Inlinable shares the body with other modules.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, but then the body is public, so change it carefully.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. Inlinable crosses the module line, then Generic Specialization does the rest.
Whole Module Optimization sees every file, but only in one module.
